posts.title: I need to rename Tend
posts.description: Tend is the name of the budgeting app I’ve been working on for the past 3 years. In fact, seeing the word Tend in a book somewhere was the spark that got me working on it in the first place. I saw the word, loved it, then found tend.cash as a domain name. posts.title: Mental tricks to keep working on my work
posts.description: I tried to imagine that today was a weekend where I had lots of free time. On weekends, work feels more fun. There’s less pressure. I’m not supposed to be working, so any work I do feels like extra credit. For some reason, obligation strips the fun out of things.
